title: PROMPTING FAIRNESS: INTEGRATING CAUSALITY TO DEBIAS LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured social bias in question-answering contexts related to religion, specifically by evaluating model accuracy on disambiguous questions where a correct answer is provided.
findings: Using the BBQ benchmark, the study found that GPT-4's default performance was significantly lower in the religion category (74.17% accuracy) compared to other categories, indicating a higher level of bias. The proposed Dual Directional Prompting (DDP) method was highly effective, significantly improving accuracy to 97.58% and outperforming other baseline debiasing techniques.
references: Abubakar Abid, Maheen Farooqi, and James Zou. Large language models associate muslims with violence. Nature Machine Intelligence, 3(6):461–463, 2021.
